reader.requirement: At --std 85, an arithmetic expression must be evaluated parenthesized sets first, innermost first, and otherwise in the order unary plus/minus, then exponentiation, then multiplication/division, then addition/subtraction (with GR2's left-to-right order inside one level), in every statement that takes an arithmetic expression (COMPUTE, relation and sign conditions).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.NegativeBaseRequiresIntegerExponent picks the negative-base rule (realRoots) carried on BoundPower: §1985:VI.6.2.3 GR5c at 85; it does not change the order of evaluation (the left-fold over the ** chain is the same at every edition)

reader.edition-search: grep of CobolExpressions.g4 and ExpressionBinder.cs BindExprCore/BindChain/BindPower/BindPrimary for DialectBehavior/Edition/DialectLevel: the only edition input on the precedence path is BindPower's negative-base flag
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: precedence is the grammar's tiering (additive > multiplicative > power > unary > primary) and a left fold per tier at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf14_01 covers each tier, nested and same-level parentheses and unary over **; not exercised: left-to-right within one level (- - and / / and ** **), unary after a binary operator, precedence inside a condition

probes.printed: COBOL0001 near '*' (A + * B); COBOL5506 near '.' (unbalanced parenthesis)
probes.expected: invalid symbol pair and unbalanced parentheses refused (GR3 Table 1, GR4)

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.2.3 GR1  (║6.2.3 Formation and Evaluation Rules║)  the text is in GR1
OK  §1985:VI.6.2.3 GR2  (║6.2.3 Formation and Evaluation Rules║)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: The grammar's tiers encode GR1's hierarchy and ExpressionBinder folds each tier left to right, so ** chains are left-associative as 1985 GR2 requires. The unaryExpression in the power base gives (-x)**n, the 1985 order. Only the negative-base rule (GR5c) consults the edition, off this rule's path.

refuter.evidence: rarx1.cob at --std 85 and 2023 (rarx1-001, -002, identical): 2 ** - 1 ** 2 = 0.25 (unary first, then left to right); - A ** 2 * 3 = 12; - (A + 1) ** 2 = 9 (parentheses, then unary, then power); 8 / A ** 2 = 2; A - B ** 2 = -7; A + + B = 5; - A - B = -5; mixed tiers 5; (A - B) ** 2 = 1; 2 ** (B - 1) ** 3 = 64 (left to right per GR2, not 256); precedence in a sign condition, an EVALUATE subject, an EVALUATE TRUE relation and a WHEN THRU range all OK. rarx2.cob --compile-only: '- - A' and '+ - A' refused COBOL1719 (Table 1 unary-unary pair), 'A ( )' refused COBOL2309. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.2.3 GR1 '1st - Unary plus and minus'; OK §1985:VI.6.2.3 GR2 'from left to right'; OK §1985:VI.6.2.3 SR3 (Table 1; GR3 FAILs, it is typed SR3).
